get.description:
Get a collection of `Transfer` orders.
The result set can be restricted through filter parameter.
Only `Transfer` orders will be returned that can be accessed by the user (security applied).
Paging is supported with parameters *limit* and *offset*.

*Get a `Transfer` order by ID*.
Only `Transfer` order will be returned that can be accessed by the user (security applied).
If user does not have access to resource, not found error will be returned instead of unauthorized - to disallow attacks.

parameters.name: doc_xfer_id
parameters.description: ID of the `Transfer` order to get

patch.description:
*Partially modify/update an existing `Transfer` order identified by ID*.
Only `Transfer` order will be replaced that can be accessed by the user (security applied).
If user does not have access to resource, not found error will be returned instead of unauthorized - to disallow attacks.

parameters.name: doc_xfer_id
parameters.description: ID of the `Transfer` order to modify/update
